add.name: Sky_ceiling_default_hole_1
add.note: Transmitted sky at the measured inner roof-hole mouth, local (0,.15,0), inside the open shaft. Five downward rays clear the aperture at the centre and corners. Full authored rotation and scale place it; far fog cap is represented by outgoing aperture light.

add.name: Sky_ceiling_default_broken02_1
add.note: Measured broken roof-hole mouth at local (.2,-.28,0), .4 square, 480 nits. Represents outgoing light just below the inner ceiling face. Five rays through the authored aperture clear; no broad area source hidden inside solid stone.

add.name: Sky_ceiling_default_cracked_2
add.note: Measured narrow crack: local (-.03,-.28,-.4), .04m across and .4m long (.5 with scale1.25), 1200 nits. Five downward rays through the opening clear at the top face; the source represents transmitted light just below the inner ceiling face at y-.25, so stones cannot falsely block it.
